evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: We'll go ahead and get you coded and walk you through how our pricing works. We'll just ask you a few information in order for us to build a perfect code you can depend on would that be okay? [Rep does not wait for explicit yes before continuing.]
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Do we have any concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer during this call today? [Asked after probing had already begun — rep had already asked about moving date and property type.]
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: When do you plan in moving [date: Sunday November 8th]; what are we moving [apartment house]; current address [1916 Bernard Street, Houston, Texas 77098]; destination address [3508 Sul Ross, Houston, Texas 77006]; box count and furniture items enumerated [couch, bed, dresser, computer table, ~10 boxes].
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Stories [2 at origin, 3 at destination]; bedrooms [2]; additional rooms [none]; walking distance [park in front]; access concerns [step up to front door]; special items [dining table, fragile items moving separately]; box count [approximately 10]; parking at destination [driveway].
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch: Rep correctly identified that home sizes exceed 1,800 sq ft (origin 2,528 sq ft, destination 2,369 sq ft) and offered virtual walkthrough: 'Normally, based on your home size we do a virtual walkthrough. In that way, we will just base it on the items that we're moving. Do you have time to complete the virtual walkthrough today?' Customer confirmed availability at 3:30 PM, rep sent link and confirmed next steps.

top_strength: Rep methodically gathered all critical logistics details (property type, stories, bedrooms, access, parking, special items, box count) and correctly routed the call to a virtual walkthrough by identifying the 2,300+ sq ft homes, setting a specific time (3:30 PM) and explaining clearly what the walkthrough would entail.
coaching_note: Strengthen the quid pro quo framing in Section 1 — present the time-boxed structure and dependable quote promise, then **pause and wait** for explicit customer agreement before moving forward; currently rep rushes past without confirming customer buy-in, and ask their agenda **before** launching into probing questions to establish their priorities first.
